artifact_protocol.artifact_identity: complete bytes and normalized relative path; digest is commitment and index only

authorization_protocol.canonical_record_encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, one trailing LF, and duplicate keys rejected
authorization_protocol.execution_authorized_field_semantics: false means the P0 and launcher contracts alone authorize no execution; authorization can only come from a matching unconsumed external phase record

cgroup_protocol.full_pipeline_accounting: from the pre-exec deadline record through archive, extraction, producer, both verifiers, copying, metadata changes, fsync, atomic rename, parent fsync, and post-publication verification
cgroup_protocol.memory_peak_formula: monitor memory.peak plus inner memory.peak; no max-of-groups substitution
cgroup_protocol.placement: watchdog/monitor and every descendant are in monitor cgroup; inner supervisor and every operational descendant are in inner sibling cgroup before any source or output byte is read

cpuset_protocol.physical_core_selection: four distinct physical package/core pairs from the launcher's inherited allowed set, lowest CPU per pair, ascending

identity_network_protocol.host_network_fd_source: watchdog opens the host network namespace before unshare and passes a read-only descriptor solely for the negative setns proof

implementation_status.whole_run_policy: NO_GO until an independently audited launcher source freeze binds every launcher, schema, test, executable dependency, and shared-library dependency

launcher_boundary.inner: The inner supervisor performs every source/archive/output operation inside the inner cgroup and private namespaces; it cannot publish directly and communicates only framed closed-schema records over a pre-opened SOCK_SEQPACKET channel.
launcher_boundary.monitor: The external watchdog records the deadline before inner exec, owns pidfds/cgroupfds/namespace fds, validates every frozen descriptor, services quiescence handshakes, applies hard kill, validates receipts, and performs only the final same-filesystem rename/fsync/post-check while itself remains in the monitor cgroup.
launcher_boundary.pre_migration_rule: Before monitor cgroup migration, only fixed CLI parsing and cgroup creation are allowed; VmSize and elapsed time are recorded and conservatively included in resource receipts.
launcher_boundary.trust_boundary: Inner reports never satisfy a gate by assertion; the monitor independently reads cgroup, mount, process, file, metadata, and clock state.

authorized_writable_mounts.purpose: all source archives, extraction, compiler output, runner output, logs, HOME, TMPDIR, TEMP, and TMP

publication_protocol.atomicity: hidden stage and final output are direct children of /opt/chemgraph/results on the same filesystem; renameat2 without replacement then fsync parent
publication_protocol.failure_policy: Any false or missing gate forbids authoritative rename; dry-run NO_GO output is stored only outside /opt/chemgraph/results.
ordering: compute and verify content plus metadata root
verify logical and allocated size gates
reopen by descriptor and independently verify bytes, metadata, roots, gates, and immutability
publication_protocol.post_publication_failure: rename back to hidden quarantine before reporting NO_GO; never leave an authoritative-looking path
publication_protocol.root_semantics: resource_validation records an evidence tree root excluding itself; a detached monitor receipt created after rename records the complete published content-and-metadata root

source_binding.dependency_binding: The complete commit archive is authoritative for v0.4/v0.5 dependencies and P0 files; extracted E2 file bytes are independently compared with the separately frozen E2 subtree archive.
source_binding.launcher_source_freeze: required after implementation and before any execution; must bind launcher source commit, contract/schema hashes, test hashes, all external tool descriptors, shared-library closure, and kernel/runtime identity

source_freeze_snapshot.copy_rule: read once, hash the same byte buffer, write exclusive private snapshot, fsync, rehash snapshot, and never reread mutable workspace

stage_quiescence.daemon_escape_policy: The stage identity cannot write cgroup.procs or migrate descendants; any process outside the assigned stage subtree is whole-run NO_GO.
stage_quiescence.handshake: Inner sends stage-complete over SOCK_SEQPACKET; monitor freezes the stage cgroup, waits for frozen=1, verifies the expected supervisor PID and zero stage descendants, captures immutable file descriptors and full-byte snapshots, then removes the empty stage cgroup before acknowledging continuation.
stage_quiescence.snapshot_policy: Subsequent stages consume monitor-frozen descriptors or root-owned read-only snapshots only; pathname reopening of mutable outputs is forbidden.
stage_quiescence.worker_proof: For each semantic stage the monitor must observe exactly four distinct worker PIDs, two assigned pairs per worker, full pair coverage without overlap, and no survivor after stage completion.

wall_protocol.deadline_start: external watchdog samples the clock immediately before inner fork/exec and before any archive, source, tool, or output byte is processed
wall_protocol.hard_kill: timerfd absolute deadline at start+1800 seconds; expiration immediately writes cgroup.kill to inner and monitor worker subtrees, waits for empty cgroups, and forbids publication
wall_protocol.wall_upper_rule: ceil(deadline_elapsed_at_final_postcheck); no publication reserve may extend the deadline
